name: narrative-rotation
author: MEFAI
summary: Rank symbols by realized expectancy and skill from labeled outcome history, then optionally tilt the shortlist with live CoinMarketCap narrative and momentum, producing a rotation watchlist of proven leaders.

inputs.name: min_samples
inputs.description: Minimum resolved trades for a symbol to qualify.

inputs.name: since_ts
inputs.description: Unix seconds floor for a live forward window.

outputs.name: entries
outputs.description: Ranked EntityStats: expectancy, win_rate, skill, realized_pnl, drawdown, sample counts.

outputs.name: overall
outputs.description: Global baseline stats across all qualified symbols.

outputs.name: qualified
outputs.description: Count of symbols clearing the sample gate.

primary.description: Realized per-symbol expectancy and skill from 181k labeled MEFAI signal outcomes (pinned synthetic sample for reproducible backtests).

backtest.pass_criteria: The ranking forms a clean disjoint top vs bottom partition where the top basket beats both the global baseline and the bottom basket on realized expectancy.
